notes.title: Headspun Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
**taps mic** this thing still on? 

Hello! It’s been a while, but we’re back with a big Headspun update to let you know that we’ve released a brand new demo for the game. 

You can now play the full first day of Headspun, where Theo Kavinsky wakes from his coma for the first time, and Ted and Teddy - the voices in his head - deal with the aftermath inside his brain. 

Headspun is an FMV/Adventure hybrid which puts you in the shoes of Ted: the Director of Cortex - the rational, intelligent voice in Theo's head. What Ted thinks is best for Theo isn't necessarily a view shared by Teddy, however; the primal, emotional subconscious voice...

If you enjoy what you play, we’ve also dropped the price of the full game, AND slashed 50% off for a week-long deal (ends July 25th) so you can carry on playing to find out how Theo, Ted and Teddy’s stories end. 

We’ve ALSO released a new Superstring bundle, which includes Headspun and our brand new game Acolyte. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32267491/2c210e85de18092ad6f649e93a6be74ccfacc10c.png

Acolyte is a natural-language ARG/Detective game that gives you your own Acolyte; a digital assistant you can talk to freely without pre-define dialogue options.

Play Acolyte today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1516330/Acolyte/

Thanks, and until next time, 

Jamin & the Superstring Team.

notes.title: Anniversary Sale!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=jifwXmv6kVA;full][/previewyoutube]

To celebrate the one year anniversary of the FMV-hybrid, we are proud to offer our biggest Steam discount on Headspun... saving you 55%!

So, for everyone new to the FMV/adventure hybrid... what is Headspun all about?

A GAME ABOUT RECOVERY

Cortex is in ruins.

After waking from a five-week coma, Theo Kavinsky finds his life in disrepair, and with no memory of the accident, it’s up to Ted and Teddy – the conscious and subconscious voices in his head – to work out what happened, and put his life back on track.

Headspun is an FMV/Adventure hybrid which puts you in the shoes of Ted: the Director of Cortex - the rational, intelligent voice in Theo's head. What Ted thinks is best for Theo isn't necessarily a view shared by Teddy, however; the primal, emotional subconscious voice...

In the process of repairing Cortex, re-hiring a team and finding out what happened the night of the accident, Ted and Teddy must cast aside their differences and learn to work together. Headspun is a game about recovery, discovery, and the ongoing battle between logic and emotion.

 Rich FMV story-telling
 Branching dialogue - sway the outcome of your interactions
 Rebuild Cortex - earn Neuros to hire staff and commission renovations
 Retreive Lost Memories and work out what happened the night of Theo's accident
 Original Synthwave Score from Soho Loop

notes.title: #11 | Patch notes
notes.content:
Dear players, 

We have collated a list of major bug fixes since the launch of the game on 28.08. 


Fixed a rare issue where all videos wouldn't play for some players. Please note, some users on Windows 7 may still have issues, additionally, anyone missing the necessary video codecs on their version of Windows may also have issues. Please see this thread for more details.
Fixed an issue where the final video wouldn't end the game.
Fixed a rare issue where input would be ignored entirely.
Fixed a visual issue where players couldn't progress as Memory 13 appeared to not unlock. Now, the unlocked padlock icon appears for players to select.
Fixed an issue where staff members wouldn't appear in a certain place when completing the Corpse Correction task.
Fixed an issue where the progress wouldn't update after assigning staff to tasks.
Fixed an issue where you can't summon multiple staff in succession. 
Fixed a rare issue where you could accidentally skip passed the tutorial. 
Fixed an issue where a task assignment was going to the wrong staff member. 
Fixed numerous achievements that occasionally didn't unlock, specifically BRIGHT SPARK, CHANGING ROOMS, UNSPUN and SNAPPY DRESSER.
Fixed an issue where you are unable to choose to stay or leave at the end of the game.
Fixed an issue where some videos wouldn't play at the appropriate times. 
Fixed an issue where the wrong video was played in Dream Theatre.
Fixed an issue where there was a time delay when entering Cortex Control.
Fixed an issue with the menu navigation when summoning and dismissing staff.
Fixed an issue where Dennis would be summoned in the same spot multiple times.
Fixed an issue where the left elevator wasn't usable after repairing it.
Fixed a rare issue where Cortex Control would become unresponsive upon leaving midday. 
Fixed an issue where the number of completed quests wasn't showing correctly.
Fixed an issue where audio levels were unbalanced in scene 8.
Fixed an issue where some subtitles were missing.
Fixed an issue with the formatting of some subtitles.
Fixed an issue where mouse input wouldn't be registered on the R&D project window. 


Additionally, a large number of smaller bugs, tweaks and optimisations have been made throughout the game. We will continue to monitor all reports and react to address the issues across all platforms (Steam, PS4, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch).

notes.title: #10 | An update from the developers
notes.content:
To the community,

This is just a quick post to let you know we are recording any and all bug reports sent our way, on all platforms. We have been patching the game on almost a daily basis and will continue this for as long as needed. Later this week (05-09) we will be making an announcement with all those fixes collated in one post, so keep an eye out for that announcement. 

We're sorry for any bugs that made it into the game and we want you to know our team are making these our highest priority. We expect the last of them to be fixed by the end of this week. 

If there are any specific bug fixes you have been waiting on since the day of launch, please update the game and verify the integrity to check if it has been implemented (or wait until the announcement this Thursday). 

Thank you to all for your support ːsteamhappyː

Wales Interactive

notes.title: #6 | Headspun Release; a schedule update with new publishers Wales Interactive
notes.content:
You might be wondering why Headspun has taken a little longer than expected to launch and I'm here to reveal all. I'm pleased to announce that Wales Interactive is collaborating with Superstring to bring Headspun to PC, Mac, PlayStation 4, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch under the Wales Interactive games label. So we've put in some extra dev time to port the game on all platforms as well as some optimisations that cover full controller support and support for multi-language subtitles. 

The list of languages is unconfirmed right now but comment below and let us know what language you would like to see featured in the game! 

We're excited to be working alongside Jamin at Superstring to bring this game to Steam and console platforms. If anyone has been following our Publisher collection then you'll know we have a soft spot for story-rich games, especially those featuring FMV (full motion video).

We're on track for a release on all platforms this summer and we will be announcing the date very soon. 

Also, we will be hosting a game giveaway very soon for those who have added the game to their Steam Wishlist.  

Wishlist on Steam 
Subscribe to the Forum 

If you haven't seen it already, here's the new trailer. Let us know what you think in the comments below. 

Wales Interactive

https://youtu.be/jifwXmv6kVA

notes.title: #2 | Rebuilding Cortex; a closer look at the features of Headspun
notes.content:
Hullo, 

Hope everybody had a smashing Easter. Some good news from Superstring: Headspun has now - kinda-sorta-unofficially - hit its alpha milestone!

The last placeholder game-asset was swapped out over the weekend, and the game is now playable from start to finish - which means the game is *technically* content complete. There's still a lot of work to be done, but Headspun is still on track for release a little later this year - we hope to be able to furnish you with a release date soon. 

In the meantime, we were keen to share more insight into what you actually *do* in the game...
 

A GAME ABOUT RECOVERY

In Headpsun, Theo wakes from a five-week coma, and Cortex - the world of his brain - is in a bit of a state. The game's narrative revolves around his recovery after this accident; of recovering his lost memories and getting better. It's more than just a plot point, however. 

On a gameplay level, this means earning resources - Neurocredits (or Neuros) - to commission repairs to the game world. As Ted, the director of Cortex, you can build new rooms which will increase Theo's Cortex Power, and further his recovery. Each room also has various other benefits and features. The R&D Lab, for example, allows you to research new additions and enhancements for the store, which you can then commission. The Reverie Bar, on the other hand, raises your staff's morale, making them happier and more efficient employees. 

Theo's recovery will be directly reflected in the environment as you progress in the game. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32267491/d1dbab250d9baae6b0726cb5741f3c1350d0cc81.jpg

        
Hopefully that gives you a little more insight into the game and what Theo's recovery actually means in terms of the game's features. We'll be sharing more very soon. 

Until next time, then! 

Jamin
